title: Checking Pending Replacement Card Orders (Internal)
summary: This internal procedure covers how to check whether a credit card account has pending replacement card orders using the get_pending_replacement_orders_5765 tool with a credit_card_account_id. It explains decision rules for account closure (block until replacement is delivered or cancelled), how to interpret order statuses, and troubleshooting for invalid IDs, access errors, or ambiguous responses.
faqs: How do I check if a credit_card_account_id has any pending replacement card orders?
What tool do I call (and with what parameter) to retrieve pending replacement orders?
If orders are returned, when is it OK to proceed with account closure?
How should I interpret mixed order statuses (pending/shipped vs delivered/cancelled)?
What should I do if I get an invalid credit_card_account_id or an access denied error?
What do I do if the tool response is empty or ambiguous? (Retry/escalate guidance)
